//@title Rockstar speech piano
//@by stretch___beatz

// Run a Rockstar program with spoken lyrics
// Martyn Eggleton
const { init, rockstar, rockstar_pro, to_base } = await import('https://esm.sh/rockstar-strudel')
await init()

const prog = await rockstar_pro`
  Papa was a rolling stone
  (Wherever he laid his hat)
  (was his home)
  (And when he died)
  (All he left us was alone)
  Say Papa
  Papa is with so much...
  Scream Papa
  He was with him
  Say Papa
`
const rhythm_numbers = to_base(prog.output, 12)

samples('shabda/speech:'+prog.speech.join(','))

$: s(slowcat(prog.speech.slice(0,6)).degradeBy(.95)).fscope()

$: note(seq(to_base(prog.output, 12))
  .euclid(seq(rhythm_numbers.flat(2)),16)
  .scale("C:major")
)
.sound("piano").every(4, rev)._pianoroll()

$: s("bd").euclid(seq(rhythm_numbers[0]),16)
$: s("bd").euclid(seq(rhythm_numbers[1]),16)
$: s("sd").euclid(rhythm_numbers[1][1],16)
$: s("hh").euclid(seq(rhythm_numbers[2]),16)

const { init, rockstar, rockstar_pro, to_base } = await import('https://esm.sh/rockstar-strudel')

const cc = await midin('Launch Control')
const kb = await midikeys('Launch Control')

$: note("c a f e")
  .lpf(cc(21).range(0, 1000))
  .lpq(cc(41).range(0, 10))
  .sound(chooseWith(
    cc(21), 
    ["sawtooth", "casio"])
         )


$: "hh".s()
  .struct(binary(cc(24).range(1,16).round())).fast(4)


 $: note(  cc(21).range(0,10).scale("C:major"))
   .euclid(cc(22).range(1,16).round(),16)
   .every(cc(23).range(0,16).round(),jux(rev))
   
  .s("sawtooth").lpf(cc(42).range(50,100)).lpe(6).lpd(0.1).room(cc(22).range(0,2)).delay(0.35)
